links.comparator_used: Vendor-provided pretrained model (VPM) used as-is, without localized fine-tuning
links.outcome: Auto-segmentation accuracy for rectal cancer CTV and organs-at-risk (DSC, 95HD, sensitivity, specificity, target volume)
links.effect: Localized fine-tuning significantly improved CTV delineation accuracy (p < 0.05), with LFT outperforming VPM in target volume, DSC, 95HD and specificity. LFT significantly improved segmentation of the small intestine. Both models were adequately accurate for bladder and femoral heads. No performance degradation was seen on the GenEva dataset from a different CT simulator for either model. No numeric DSC or HD values are given in the abstract.
links.quote: Localized fine-tuning significantly improved CTV delineation accuracy (p < 0.05) with LFT outperforming VPM in target volume, DSC, 95HD and specificity.
